create_numel_dataset: create a NumelDataset wrapper that returns element counts for each item in a dataset
use_getitem_numel: use NumelDataset getitem to get the number of elements in a tensor or numpy array at a given index
collate_reduce_sum: collate samples with reduce mode to sum all element counts across a batch of dataset items
collate_tensor_samples: collate samples without reduce mode to return a tensor of individual element counts
review_numel_dataset_class: review the NumelDataset class and its reduce flag for controlling collation behavior
